about.intro: UV Clinics is a six-department beauty and skin clinic in Miyapur, Hyderabad — dermatology, aesthetics, dental, salon, nails and makeup under one roof, with doctors on site rather than on call.
about.story:
Most salons can cut hair. Most clinics can treat skin. UV Clinics was built so you do not have to choose between the two, or drive across the city between appointments.

Under one roof in Mirra Guduru Plaza: a dermatology and aesthetics floor led by in-house doctors, a dental chair, a full salon, Hyderabad's first Korean-themed nail studio and a makeup room. The idea is simple — one visit, one set of records, and a plan that treats the skin, the smile and the hair as parts of the same person.

Where science meets style.

announcements.text: HydraFacial ₹999 · Haircut + L’Oréal hair spa ₹999 · Carbon peel laser ₹1,499 — call 88868 68929

policies.shipping: Offer prices are as published on the clinic's Instagram and can change without notice. Final pricing is confirmed at consultation, once skin, hair length and dental needs have been assessed. Payment is taken at the clinic by cash, card or UPI.
policies.returns: Laser, peel and PMU appointments need a consultation or patch test first. Please give at least 12 hours notice to move an appointment so the slot can be offered to someone else. Treatment packages are non-refundable once started.

products.name: HydraFacial
products.description: A medical-grade cleanse, exfoliation and hydration in one pass — blackhead extraction without the picking, and skin that stays plump for days. The clinic's most-booked facial, and the one to start with if you have never had a treatment before.
products.care: Sunscreen daily for a week. Skip retinol and strong actives for 48 hours after.
products.colour: Dull, congested or dehydrated skin; safe for most skin types after consultation

products.name: Skin & Hair Consultation
products.description: Sit with the in-house doctor before anything is booked. We look at the skin or scalp, explain what is actually happening, and put together a plan — sometimes that plan is one facial, sometimes it is none.
products.care: Bring a list of anything you currently use, including prescriptions.
products.colour: Acne, pigmentation, hair fall, hair thinning or a second opinion

products.name: Chemical Peel
products.description: A controlled peel chosen for your concern — texture, tan, pigmentation or post-acne marks — with the strength decided at the chair rather than on a menu. Series pricing is shared after the consultation.
products.care: Strict sunscreen, no picking, and no waxing or threading for a week.
products.colour: Uneven tone, tan, acne marks and mild texture

products.name: Acne & Pigmentation Care
products.description: A treatment plan rather than a single facial: in-clinic work combined with a routine you can actually keep up at home. Reviewed every few weeks so progress is measured, not guessed.
products.care: Consistency matters more than intensity — we will tell you what to drop.
products.colour: Active acne, hormonal breakouts, melasma and post-inflammatory marks

products.name: Carbon Peel Laser
products.description: A carbon lotion is laid over the skin, then cleared with a laser pass — the closest thing to a resurfacing facial for oily, textured and acne-prone skin. Pores look tighter immediately; tone improves over the series.
products.care: No make-up for 12 hours, sunscreen daily, avoid heat and swimming for 48 hours.
products.colour: Oily skin, enlarged pores, dullness and mild acne scarring

products.name: Full Body Laser Hair Reduction
products.description: Medical-grade laser hair reduction for the full body, done in comfortable sessions by trained staff. A patch test and a consultation come first, so the settings suit your skin tone, not a default.
products.care: Shave — do not wax or thread — for four weeks before. Sunscreen on exposed areas.
products.colour: Unwanted body hair; suitability confirmed at the patch test

products.name: Permanent Makeup (PMU)
products.description: Soft, natural permanent makeup for brows and lips — mapped to your face, drawn first in pencil, and built up over two sittings so nothing looks stamped on. Includes the touch-up.
products.care: Keep the area dry for a week, avoid gyms and saunas, and follow the aftercare sheet.
products.colour: Sparse brows, asymmetry or lips that need definition rather than colour

products.name: Teeth Scaling & Polishing
products.description: Ultrasonic scaling followed by polishing — the tidy-up that makes whitening treatments actually look like whitening. Includes a short dental check so anything that needs attention is flagged early.
products.care: Avoid very hot or cold food for a day; sensitivity settles within a week.
products.colour: Staining, tartar build-up and routine six-monthly cleaning

products.name: Cosmetic Dental Restoration
products.description: Composite bonding and cementation for chipped, spaced or worn front teeth — conservative work that keeps the natural tooth underneath. Shade and shape are matched before anything is set.
products.fabric: Varies by tooth · quoted after examination
products.care: Avoid biting nails and hard seeds; a six-month polish keeps the edges clean.
products.colour: Chips, gaps, discoloured fillings and worn edges

products.name: Haircut + L'Oréal Hair Spa
products.description: The clinic's signature salon offer: a cut shaped to your face and hair fall, followed by a L'Oréal spa ritual — warm oil, scalp massage and a mask matched to your hair. Walk out lighter.
products.care: Use a sulphate-free wash and a weekly mask to keep the softness.
products.colour: Anyone due for a reset; asked for by both men and women

products.name: Hair Smoothening
products.description: A smoothing treatment sealed in with heat — hair that dries straight, behaves in Hyderabad humidity and still moves. Published as an offer at ₹1,999; the final quote depends on length and density.
products.care: No washing or tying back for 72 hours. Sulphate-free wash afterwards.

products.name: Global Hair Colour
products.description: One considered shade from root to tip, applied in sections and finished with a toner so it suits your skin. Grey coverage, a deep tone change or a refresh before a function.
products.care: Colour-safe wash, weekly mask, roots refreshed every 4–6 weeks.
products.colour: Grey coverage or an all-over tone change

products.name: Korean Gel Nail Art
products.description: Hyderabad's first Korean-themed nail studio, and the reason people travel across the city: glossy gel colour with hand-painted art, chrome, syrup and marble finishes. Published at ₹299 for both hands on a plain gel paint.
products.care: Cuticle oil daily; book a soak-off removal rather than peeling the gel.
products.colour: A clean, glossy everyday set or a full art set for an occasion

products.name: Nail Extensions
products.description: Gel and acrylic extensions built to a length you can live with, shaped, then finished with colour or art. Published at ₹799 for a first set.
products.care: Avoid using your nails as tools; refills every 3–4 weeks.
products.colour: Length, an even shape, or repairing a broken nail before an event

products.name: Luxury Manicure & Pedicure
products.description: A proper soak, scrub, cuticle work and massage — the pair that keeps hands and feet looking maintained between nail appointments. The clinic runs a buy-one-get-one offer on the premium pair; ask when booking.
products.care: Moisturise nightly; book the pair every 3–4 weeks.
products.colour: Dry hands, tired feet, or prep before a function

products.name: Bridal & Party Makeup
products.description: Makeup that reads well in photographs and still looks like you in person — long-wear base, HD finish and lashes, built to survive a full function. Trials are booked ahead of the date.
products.care: Book the trial at least two weeks before. Come with clean, moisturised skin.
products.colour: Bridal, engagement, reception, sangeet and party looks
